notes.title: The Poet and Delirium Tremens
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/2e771f78126c6213824f1b0489671d6d06b7a100.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A poet is a person with a soul made of delicate glass. Seeing the horrors of the plague, he did not break down, but turned to the bottle, trying to wash away the bloody images with hops. However, even in oblivion, his mind continues to create: whispering rhymes about death, love, and hope...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/3f71a83d052bc4761901fa3d466d849b0b498561.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Raven Bane unexpectedly joined in his creative process — the feathered cynic began to caw poems of his own composition. His lines are sharp, gloomy, but full of strange wisdom...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/92559b98ca3c07a36669d43764f8a7fd195cd2bb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Cultists' storyline
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/cbdf48d2149ccf9cbfff027b36ae233e19b60688.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Hello, everyone! Initially, The Book of Plague was supposed to end with the ninth chapter... but plans changed. Fate intervened in the story—and now the ending takes on new meaning.[/p][p]We're talking about a sect that sees the plague not as a curse, but as purification. A cult that seeks salvation of the soul through suffering of the body. Their story has become the most complex in the game — with a dozen characters and... a whole 10 ending options.[/p][p]This is the biggest mystery in the game. And I can't wait for it to be revealed...[/p][p]Have a peaceful weekend. And may the force be with you... [img src="https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t57/1/16/1f609.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The city's water supplies are running out! What should we do?
notes.notes: [h3]A man lost in the desert must take such water as he is offered, no matter who it comes from... - Joe Abercrombie, “The First Law”.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/9d646562962cbb7db7d24972d5c83ee5a9bf44ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This quote perfectly captures the essence of today's problem in The Book of Plagues. The city's fresh water supplies are running out, and the wells are contaminated with the plague bacillus. People are desperate and willing to do anything for a sip of clean water.[/p][p]What should be done? I suggest we brainstorm and create an edict by choosing one of three options and writing it in the comments! I will post the results of the most popular edict based on the poll here later... Let's go![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/81306eb1fa0e1b224d7c7dc1ee713ad9c17dea8c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The story of the revived dead...
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/51a64b672a96a3dc26fd4c44253a7137ba5d6f73.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When I started this project, I couldn't have imagined how deep and complex it would become. Thank you for staying with me and waiting patiently — today I want to be honest about why development is taking so long.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/3815bc77d9946cab9c06df8ea200e466dd4a4ec1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The thing is, the fates of every resident of our city are not just threads, but a real web, where every decision and accident has consequences. Take, for example, the most insignificant character — a drunk who fell asleep on the pavement.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/060627d0db6b838c3547e021d95b7b5eb4f148e6.jpg"][/img][/p][p]What's so special about him, you might ask? The corpse collectors mistake him for another victim of the plague, load him into a cart, and take him to the cemetery. But this is where things get interesting: on the way, he contracts pneumonic plague, the most rapid and dangerous form of the disease.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/bf94a197a9e2969c4d0476280634166b825a4631.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If he can be cured, he will infect his daughter, who has cared for him all her life despite his drunken antics. If not, the drunkard will lose his mind and infect a random townswoman with the “kiss of death,” and the guards will be forced to stop him the only way they know how — with bows and arrows.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550157/d1bb3bbdaa50bcb32f3b2416ec139975a3ac448c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is how the project weaves itself into a single, complex tangle — and my main task as a storyteller is to not let a single thread break. After all, it would be a bitter disappointment if the “gun” hanging on the wall from the first act turned out to be unloaded in the finale.[/p]

notes.title: A major update to The Book of Plagues!
notes.notes: [p]Steam Next Fest helped me identify the project's weaknesses, which is important.[/p][p]First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who took the time to try out The Book of Plagues and share their impressions! Special respect to those who, despite the flaws, believed in the game and added it to their wishlist. You are the BEST![/p][p]The feedback from players has been invaluable: now I can clearly see which direction to move in. Special thanks to those who pointed out specific problems — your criticism has prompted important decisions.[/p][p]And today I want to talk about the main Achilles' heel of the project — the graphics.[/p][p]I know that the use of neural networks is controversial for many. Yes, it's not a “magic pill,” and I understand its limitations perfectly well. I myself started drawing not so long ago, and my skills are not yet sufficient to cover all the artistic needs of the game on my own.[/p][p]But I am learning — correcting color, light, composition, and I can already see progress. Neural networks help with this: you could say we are learning from each other.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]So, point by point:[/b][/h3][p][u]New art style[/u]:[/p][p]The game has been completely redesigned in the spirit of dark medieval woodcuts — now the world of The Book of Plagues looks as if it were carved on wood. But the recognizable combination of black, white, and red is still there.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Characters:[/u][/p][p]All characters have received:[/p][p]  -Revised proportions and poses,[/p][p]  -Deep, natural shadows and colors,[/p][p]  -Details free of artifacts (no “neural network scars”!).[/p][p][/p][p]An environment:[/p][p]The infirmary has retained its eerie atmosphere, but has acquired a unique style — no more random “artifacts,” only deliberate gloom.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Interface:[/u][/p][p]All UI elements are somewhat reminiscent of medical records — as if you were leafing through the diary of a medieval doctor.[/p][p][/p][p][u]News newspaper:[/u][/p][p]The updated newspaper now features woodcut illustrations so that players can “enjoy” the consequences of their medical practice in a truly historical style.[/p][p][/p][p][u]Raven Bane:[/u][/p][p]The crowd favorite has left his cage and now sits on his master's shoulder. But his dark jokes and sarcasm are still there — he chatters away as before.[/p][p][/p][p]Result: In the full version, 32 patients received a visual upgrade (8 in the demo). Each now looks as if they were taken from a medieval chronicle.[/p][p]I continue to actively work on the game and will share news as development progresses. If you care about The Book of Plagues, please support me on your favorite social networks and share your opinions and ideas. I'm always happy to chat))  [/p][p]Thank you for staying with me. There's a lot of work ahead, but with your support, everything will work out![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The announcement!
notes.notes: [p]Dear residents of our glorious city of Ludwig! Today is a great day, for the Book of Plagues has crossed another milestone in its dark but surprisingly cheerful (yes, I don't understand how that happened myself) history! In honor of this momentous occasion, I have prepared for you, my esteemed, beloved, and most awesome subscribers, a detailed report on what I have been doing during these long eight months of development. Let's call it a trendy word - Developer's Diary![/p][p][/p][p]What has been done:[/p][p]1. The plague has spread! – At the moment, the game has 5 full chapters with characters and events that will make your hair stand on end (and then quietly fall out from stress). This is exactly half of what I plan to do...[/p][p][/p][p]2. Storylines. – 32 characters have been fully completed, written, and translated. Many of them carry story branches and influence the fate of the city more than it might seem at first glance...[/p][p][/p][p]3. Edicts! – The heavy cross of a learned doctor and the main weapon in the fight against the epidemic! There are five of them now, and each one is a painful choice between the desire to help the city's residents and the desire to save face. Signing a decree is easy. Accepting the consequences is much more difficult...[/p][p][/p][p]4. Medicines! – Twelve drugs of varying degrees of usefulness are ready and woven into the gameplay! All the necessary recipes and ingredients for their distillation are fully prepared...[/p][p][/p][p]5. Battle! – Each patient is a unique experience and a new challenge for players... The more complicated the illness, the harder it is to keep the Fragile Flower intact. No two “battles” for a patient's health will be the same![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with me! Without your support, I would have long since fallen victim to the plague and procrastination!!![/p][p][/p][p]Get ready — there is even more darkness ahead... and “sparkling” humor from the raven Paguba![/p]

notes.title: Tourette syndrome
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=WlxzWa-smMI;full][/previewyoutube]


Hello, everyone!
This week, an unusual patient arrived at the infirmary — a representative of the oldest profession! No, he doesn't sell his body or sleep for money... He slaughters livestock!
But the problem isn't his job, it's that he literally can't hold his tongue — due to deep emotional trauma, his speech has turned into a never-ending stream of profanity. People shy away from him, condemn him, and he can't cope with it.
This condition is known as Tourette's syndrome — when the nervous system rebels, causing a person to shout out whatever comes to mind.
Will the Doctor be able to help such a patient?
As before, the result of the treatment will lead to unexpected consequences...
